market_agnostic_note: Every manifest, compact-row, index and reader rule below is market-independent. A later US window adds only a sources.US block and its own collector; it changes no field name, no manifest rule, no index rule, and no reader entry point.
adjustment_note: No split/dividend adjustment is ever applied to a stored value. A return is computed by compounding the provider's own per-session change fields, never by dividing two unadjusted closes across a corporate action.

manifest_field_semantics.bas_dd: YYYYMMDD session date decided by the official calendar, never by data presence
manifest_field_semantics.endpoint: sorted list of every provider endpoint URL that contributed to this session; exactly one element for a single-endpoint market
manifest_field_semantics.requested_at_utc: instant the first request of the winning attempt was issued
manifest_field_semantics.retrieved_at_utc: instant the last part of the winning attempt was received
manifest_field_semantics.http_status: single HTTP status shared by every part of the winning attempt; parts that disagree fail closed
manifest_field_semantics.row_count: total provider rows across every part; 0 means status EMPTY
manifest_field_semantics.raw_sha256: sha256 over the canonical JSON object mapping part_id to that part's exact provider-byte sha256
manifest_field_semantics.compact_sha256: sha256 over the uncompressed compact.jsonl bytes
manifest_field_semantics.projection_version: projection_version of this contract at derivation time
manifest_field_semantics.contract_sha256: sha256 of this contract file's exact bytes
manifest_field_semantics.public_code_commit: public atlas-data commit whose collector produced this session
manifest_field_semantics.first_available_observed_at_utc: earliest retrieved_at_utc among attempts that returned rows; null while status is EMPTY
manifest_field_semantics.attempts: append-only list of every attempt: attempt_no, kind, requested_at_utc, retrieved_at_utc, http_status, row_count, outcome
manifest_field_semantics.parts: per-part part_id, endpoint, http_status, row_count, raw_relpath, raw_sha256, raw_byte_count
manifest_field_semantics.corporate_action_suspects: codes whose list_shrs is discontinuous against the immediately preceding stored session
manifest_field_semantics.source_contract_sha256: sha256 of the per-market source contract named in sources[market].source_contract_path

reader.sessions_available_at: sessions whose first_available_observed_at_utc is at or before t and whose status is OK
reader.series: exactly the stored rows for the code across the most recent n available sessions; a session with no row for that code stays a gap and is never filled, carried forward, interpolated, or padded

KR.publication_basis: Observed: a same-day 18:13 KST request returned zero rows (EMPTY) and a next-day 10:47 KST request for the same session returned rows. The provider's official publication instant is not captured in this repository; 08:00 KST next calendar day plus the 70-minute settle offset (09:10 KST) is the earliest collection, and a 0-row answer at that time is still EMPTY, never data.
